# Synthetic seeded Gradle lockfile for the OpenMedKit lockfile scan gate.
# CI copies it to a temporary app/gradle.lockfile; it is never a real module.
# log4j-core 2.14.1 is shipped (release runtime) and must block the gate.
# guava 31.1-jre is test-only and must be dropped from the release runtime view.

empty=androidApis,lintChecks
